Disabling infer_dimensions skips the decode step and still produces content

```elixir title="Elixir"
options_value = %HtmlToMarkdown.ConversionOptions{extract_images: true, infer_dimensions: false}
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>No dims: <img src=\"data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8/5+hHgAHggJ/PchI7wAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==\" alt=\"pixel\"></p>", options_value)
IO.inspect(result)
```
